stemEn: An 18-month-old child develops sudden cough, and chest radiography shows findings of an aspirated airway foreign body. What is the diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار foreign body aspiration، مع ذكر أن الأشعة قد تظهر unilateral hyperinflation، atelectasis، mediastinal shift أو pneumonia distal to obstruction.
clinicalPearl: Sudden cough plus unilateral radiographic air trapping strongly suggests foreign body aspiration.

stemEn: A child has sudden cough and unilateral right-sided wheeze. AP and lateral chest radiographs show a nail in the right bronchus. What is the next step?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار urgent bronchoscopy؛ وجود جسم غريب واضح داخل bronchus يحتاج إزالة وليس علاج bronchospasm فقط.
clinicalPearl: Confirmed bronchial foreign body requires bronchoscopic removal.

stemEn: An infant has acute shortness of breath, decreased right-sided air entry, and right lung hyperinflation on chest radiograph. What management is selected?
explanationAr: مفتاح المصدر هو urgent bronchoscopy في سياق صورة توحي air trapping من foreign body aspiration.
clinicalPearl: Unilateral hyperinflation with acute symptoms is a classic airway foreign-body clue.

stemEn: A child swallowed a button battery 3 days ago and now has hematemesis. Abdominal radiograph shows the battery still in the stomach. What is the management?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار emergency endoscopy لأن الطفل symptomatic والبطارية ما زالت بالمعدة.
clinicalPearl: Symptoms after gastric button-battery ingestion change management toward urgent removal.

stemEn: A child swallowed multiple magnets 2 days ago, and abdominal radiography shows several magnets in the stomach. What should be done?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار urgent removal ويذكر خطر pressure necrosis/perforation مع multiple magnets.
clinicalPearl: Multiple magnets are substantially more dangerous than a single inert foreign body.

stemEn: A child has caustic ingestion with lip erythema and concern for posterior pharyngeal involvement but is stable and tolerating oral intake. What is the next step?

options.text: Admit, keep NPO, and perform endoscopy the next day
Admit, keep NPO, start steroids and IV antibiotics, and perform endoscopy

explanationAr: المصدر يختار admission + NPO + endoscopic evaluation. ويشرح أن oral lesions/symptoms تجعل المراقبة المنزلية غير مناسبة، بينما steroids/antibiotics ليست routine لكل حالة.
clinicalPearl: Caustic ingestion with oral lesions warrants structured inpatient evaluation.
